dct_description_sm: Abstract: This data layer contains point locations representing all known locations of fire hydrants from the water mains data layer in Newton.

Purpose: This layer is intended for researchers, students, and policy makers for reference and mapping purposes, and may be used for basic applications such as viewing, querying, and map output production, or to provide a basemap to support graphical overlays and analysis with other spatial data. More advanced user applications may focus on urban planning and policy, public works, or utilities purposes, real property, insurance and disaster and emergency planning (including defining boundaries, managing assets and facilities, integrating attribute databases with geographic features, spatial analysis, and presentation output.)
Supplemental information: The city will be maintaining this data layer using information from city crews and from contractor crews.
dct_rights_sm: Use constraints: For educational, non-commercial use only.
